verses.text: Ix k'och Jesús t'a Jericó, ix ek' t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Hata' ay jun winh b'eyum skuchan Zaqueo. Yajal yaj winh t'a heb' tekumel alkabar t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Snib'ej winh yilani chajtil yilji Jesús. Palta max yal-laj yilan winh, yujto tzijtum anima oyanoch t'a spatik Jesús chi' ayik wan sb'eyi, yujto tzapan pax ste'el winh.
Ix b'ab'lajb'at lemnaj winh, ix k'e winh t'a sk'ab' jun te te' ayek' t'a ti' b'e, yik syil winh yek' Jesús chi'.
Haxo yik ix ek' Jesús chi' ta', ix k'e k'elnaj t'a winh, ix yalan t'a winh: --Zaqueo, emanhkot elanhchamel, yujto a tikne'ik ha t'a a pat ol wak' in posado, xchi t'a winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh icha chi', elanhchamel ix emta winh. Haxo ix k'och Jesús chi' t'a spat winh, ix scha winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
Haxo masanil heb' anima, manh jantakok ix yal heb' t'a spatik Jesús, yujto ix k'och yak' sposado t'a spat jun winh chuk sb'eyb'al chi'.

Haxo winhaj Zaqueo chi' ix k'e linhan, ix yalan winh t'a Jesús Kajal: --Ha tikne'ik Mamin, a jantak tas ay t'ayin, chapoj ol wutok. Ol wak' junok makan t'a heb' meb'a'. Tato ay mach ix laj wixtej, ix welk'ej, chanhel ol wak'pax sk'exul t'a heb', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús chi': --Ha tikne'ik, ix cha skolnab'il winh aj pat tik, yujto wal yel yinhtilalpaxkan Abraham winh.
Ha in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch anima'il tik, in jawi in say heb' satnak yik tzin kolanel heb', xchi Jesús chi'.

Yakb'an wan yab'an heb' anima tas ix yal Jesús chi', ay jun ab'ix ix yal t'a heb', yujto wan sk'och heb' t'a slak'anil Jerusalén. Ha sna'an heb' to toxo ol wach' och Dios Yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Icha tik ix yutej yalan t'a heb': --Ha junel ay jun winh winak yinhtilkan heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at winh t'a jun chonhab' te najat, yik tz'ak'ji'och winh reyal t'a schonhab'.

Ayik manto b'at winh, ix yawtankot lajunhwanh heb' schekab' winh. Ix yak'an juntzanh k'e'en tumin winh t'a heb'. Niwak sat k'e'en. Jun lajan k'e'en ix scha junjun heb'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': Hak'ek he negocio yet' k'e'en tumin tik, masanto ol in jaxok, ichato chi' ol eyak'anxi k'e'en t'ayin, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix b'at winh b'i'an.

Haxo heb' yetchonhab' winh, ix te chichon sk'o'ol heb' t'a winh. Ix schekanb'at jaywanh winak heb' t'a spatik winh, yik syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, malaj ko gana tz'och winh reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik, xchi heb'.

Wach'chom icha chi' ix yal heb', ix ochnhej winh t'a yopisio chi'. Haxo yik ix jax winh, ix laj yawtankot heb' schekab' winh chi', machtak heb' b'aj yak'nakkan k'e'en tumin chi' winh, yik syab' winh jantakxo yune' k'e'en ix yak' ganar junjun heb'.
Ix b'ab'laj k'och jun t'a winh, ix yalani: Mamin patrón, a k'e'en tumin ak'nakkan t'ayin, lajunhexo yune' k'e'en ix yak' ganar, xchi t'a winh.

Haxo ix yalan winh yajal chi': Wach' jun. Ha ach tik, te wach' ach t'ayin. Wach'chom kennhej ix wak' t'ayach, palta wach' ix utej a b'a yet'ok. Yuj chi', swak'och opisio och yajalil t'a lajunhe'ok chonhab', xchi winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och junxo schekab' winh chi'. Mamin patrón, a k'e'en a tumin ak'nakkan t'ayin, oyexo yune' k'e'en ix yak' ganar, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh: Wach' jun. Yuj chi' ol ach wak'och yajalil t'a oye' chonhab', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och junxo schekab' winh chi', ix yalan t'a winh: Patrón, ina k'e'en a tumin tik. Sik'b'ilb'at k'e'en wu'uj t'a yol jun in payu'.
Ha in tik tzin xiwi, yujto wojtak ach to junnhej b'elanh ach, yujto a ach tik, toxonhej tza cha ikej tas syak' ganar junxo anima. Toxonhej tza jach'a', palta malaj tas tzawej, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh yajal chi': Ha ach tik wach'chom in chekab' ach, palta te chuk ach. Yuj juntzanh tzal tik, swak'kanb'at t'a ib'anh. Yujto a ach wal tzala' to junnhej b'elanh in. Toxonhej tzin cha wikej tas syak' ganar junxo anima. Toxonhej tzin jach'a', palta malaj tas swawej.
Tato icha chi' tzutej a na'an t'a wib'anh, ¿tas yuj maj ak'b'at k'e'en majanil t'a junokxo, haxo tzin jax tik tzin cha'anxi k'e'en yet' yune'? xchi winh t'ay.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan t'a heb' ayek' yet' chi': Ik'ek ek' k'e'en t'a winh, tzeyak'an k'e'en t'a winh ix ak'an ganar lajunhe' yune' yiko', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Haxo ix yalan heb': Palta mamin patrón, lajunhexo k'e'en ay t'a winh, xchi heb'.
Palta swal t'ayex, a mach ayxo yiko', ol wach' ak'jok nanhalokxo t'ay. Haxo heb' malaj yiko', ol wach' ik'jokek' tas ay t'a heb'.
Yet' pax heb' wajk'o'ol, heb' malaj snib'ej tzin och yajalil, ik'ekkot heb'. Milekcham heb' t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh yajal chi', xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi yalan jun ab'ix chi' Jesús, ix scha'an pax sb'e, ix b'ab'laj yuj heb' sk'ayb'um yik sk'e heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik wan sk'och Jesús chi' yet' heb' t'a slak'anil Betfagé yet' Betania, t'a yichanhb'at tzalan Olivo t'a slak'anil Jerusalén, ix schekanb'at chawanh heb' sk'ayb'um.
Ayik manto b'at heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ixikek t'a jun chonhab' t'a kichanhb'at tik. Hata' ol eyil jun nok' b'uru, etzanoch nok'. Mantalaj mach sk'e t'a yib'anh nok'. Tze tijankot nok'.
Tato ay mach tz'alan t'ayex: ¿Tas yuj tze tijelta nok'? ta xchi heb', tzeyalan t'a heb': Ha Kajalil ay tz'och nok' yuj, xe chi, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Icha ix yutej yalan Jesús chi' t'a heb', icha chi' ix aj yilchaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj heb'.
Haxo yik wan stijanelta nok' heb', ix k'och heb' aj b'uru chi', ix yalan heb': --¿Tas yuj tze tijelta nok'? xchi heb'.
--To ay ol och nok' yuj Kajalil, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at nok' heb' t'a Jesús chi'. Ix yak'anoch spichul heb' stz'amok nok', ix yak'ank'e Jesús chi' heb' t'a yib'anh nok'.
Haxo yik wan sb'eyi, ay heb' ix laj lich'anem spichul t'a yol b'e t'a yichanh b'aj sb'eyb'at chi'.

Haxo yik wan sk'och heb' t'a jun b'e spichlaj em t'a tzalan Olivo, a jantak heb' sk'ayb'um, ix laj och ijan heb' yawajk'e yuj tzalajk'olal. Ix laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios yuj juntzanh milagro ix yil heb'.
Ix laj yalan heb' icha tik: --Kalek wach' lolonel t'a ko reyal chekb'ilkot yuj Dios Kajal. Te ay junk'olal t'a satcha'anh, te niwan yelk'och ko Diosal ta', xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ayek' t'a skal heb' anima chi' ix halan t'a Jesús chi': --Ach k'ayb'um, ¿tas yuj max a kach heb' a k'ayb'um tik? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Swal t'ayex tato tz'em numan heb', haxo juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en tik ol awajk'e'ok, xchi t'a heb'.
Haxo yik wan sk'och Jesús t'a Jerusalén, ix yilanb'at jun chonhab' chi', ix ok' yuj.
Ix yalani: --Ex aj Jerusalén, oktom wal snachajel eyu'uj t'a jun k'u tik chajtil tz'aj he cha'an sjunk'olal Dios, palta a tikne'ik, maxtzak yal-laj snachajel eyu'uj, yujto toxo ix k'ub'chajel t'ayex.
Yuj chi' ay jun pekti' ol ja t'a eyib'anh, a heb' eyajk'o'ol, ol och hoyan heb' t'a spatik yichanh he chonhab' tik. Ol laj yoyan sb'a heb' t'a he patik, ol yak'an owal heb' heyet'ok.

Ol laj smak'em weknaj jun chonhab' tik heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ol smilancham heb' anima chi' heb'. Haxo k'e'en k'e'en latz'b'ilk'e'i, manhxa junok k'e'en ol kan t'a yib'anh k'e'en yetk'enal chi'. Ha jun tik ol ja t'a eyib'anh yujto ha t'a jun pekti' tik ix ja Dios t'ayex, palta max nachajel eyu'uj, xchi Jesús.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och Jesús t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Dios. Ix spechanelta heb' schonhwaji yet' heb' smanwaji.

Ix yalan t'a heb': --Tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios icha tik: Ha in pat, yiknhej lesal yaji, xchi. Ha exxo tik, icha junok k'e'en nhak'e'en b'aj sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' elk'um, icha chi' tzeyutej, xchi t'a heb'.

Junjun k'u ix k'och Jesús chi' sk'ayb'ej anima t'a yamak'il stemplo Dios chi'. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' heb' winh yajalil jun chonhab' chi', ix say heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh smilanchamok.
Palta maj yal-laj yuj heb' winh, yujto ayoch t'a sk'o'ol heb' anima smaklan yab' t'ay.
